facts.text: A single Munich transit ticket/day pass covers U-Bahn, S-Bahn, tram, and bus within the relevant zone; central Munich's sights are close enough together that walking is often as practical as transit.
Beer hall meals (Hofbräuhaus and similar) are moderately priced (€12-20/dish) but drinks add up fast at a full liter ("Maß") per round — worth budgeting for drinks separately from food.

The Hofbräuhaus itself is genuinely popular with tourists and locals alike (not purely a trap), but restaurants immediately surrounding Marienplatz tend to be priced above smaller beer gardens and neighborhood Gaststätten a short walk away.
The Glockenspiel show at Marienplatz's New Town Hall runs at fixed times (commonly 11am and 12pm, sometimes 5pm) for only a few minutes — easy to miss if not timed deliberately.
Sundays follow the same near-total retail shutdown as elsewhere in Germany — plan shopping/grocery needs accordingly.

Bavarian cuisine is meat- and dairy-heavy (sausages, schnitzel, pretzels); dedicated vegetarian/vegan restaurants exist in the center (particularly around Glockenbachviertel) but are far more limited within traditional beer halls.
